statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the block threshold as the pre-open selloff has shown meaningful rebound from the latest delayed session low.
recommendation: Current Tail is 24%. External Stress remains extreme, while the latest delayed NQ path includes material repair from the session low rather than sustained low-holding.
headline: Upper-WATCH Tail risk as pre-open NQ rebounds from a deeper session low
body: The latest delayed NQ reference showed 29,565.00 after a 29,477.75 session low and 29,739.00 high, an approximately 87-point rebound from the low. Reuters reported Nasdaq-100 futures down 0.18%, Brent near $99 and positive chip shares, leaving severe external Stress but incomplete one-way confirmation.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 UTC clock-hour slots, published ChatGPT Tail ranged from 17% to 27% while Stress remained at 100%. The latest sequence moved from trend-up to trend-down and then event/whipsaw as the pre-open decline extended but subsequently rebounded from a deeper session low.
outlookSummary: The principal danger window remains 13:20-15:00 UTC around the first post-holiday U.S. cash open. Forecast Tail peaks conditionally at 33% in the 14:00 UTC hour only if the opening impulse remains unrepaired, holds near an extreme and repeatedly extends after failed pullbacks; meaningful two-sided repair keeps Tail below the block threshold.
